consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Kingston; Australian High Commission, Port of Spain
consular.notes: Australia has a consulate in Kingston. It provides limited consular services and conducts passport interviews. You can get full consular assistance from the Australian High Commission in Trinidad and Tobago.
